title: Forget Being a Landlord: These 3 REITs Pay You to Own Apartments
summary: Apartment REITs are legally required to hand most of their income straight to shareholders, but not all of them are equally safe bets right now. Three landlords are collecting rent checks while new construction dries up, and the differences between them could cost you real money.
